_comment: AUTHORED. Money with no usage events at all — design 1.1 names it because a flat fee reaches the totals through subscription_service rather than through usage_events_daily, and 4.2 depends on this shape too. The subscription is generic ('Other'): it has no provider_id, so it cannot fold into a card and renders as a standalone breakdown row keyed by its own id. That id is authored here because query_service puts it on the wire (provider_id=sid) and SubscriptionRepo.create would otherwise mint a random one, which would make every re-capture differ.
name: subscriptions-only

request._comment: Portfolio view: no surface is scoped. Present and empty rather than absent, so an unscoped scenario is a stated fact and not an omission.
